statement:
SELECT eo, issued_date_key, dd.calendar_date as issued_date
FROM subject_maintenanceengineering_test.an_maintenanceengineering_ods.qx_ppmtx_gold_fact_engineering_order f
LEFT JOIN subject_maintenanceengineering_test.an_maintenanceengineering_ods.qx_ppmtx_gold_dim_date dd ON f.issued_date_key = dd.dim_date_key
WHERE upper(status)='OPEN' AND upper(eo_category)='ECMP' AND eo RLIKE '^ECMP-[0-9]+$' AND CAST(substring(eo,6) AS INT) > 4500
